verdict.rationale: Restate explicitly supports external signals/events into running workflows via durable coordination primitives (promises, signals) for human approvals, webhooks, and cross-workflow communication, plus typed clients/HTTP API to invoke or send events into running invocations from outside. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on case study demonstrating a real webhook-triggered signal into a live workflow, and no explicit code sample in the pack showing the exact 'resolve awakeable/signal' API call.
